entries.original: **LSP no longer runs language servers in-process.** The LSP MCP server is now a thin proxy to the shared daemon. If the daemon is unreachable (after one retry) you get a structured `LSP daemon unreachable` result (it auto-starts on demand and retries next request) instead of a transparent in-process fallback.
entries.translated: **LSP no longer runs language servers in-process.** The LSP MCP server is now a thin proxy to the shared daemon. If the daemon is unreachable (after one retry) you get a structured `LSP daemon unreachable` result (it auto-starts on demand and retries next request) instead of a transparent in-process fallback.

entries.original: **`multi_agent_v2` is force-disabled on every Codex session start.** With it on, every Codex turn fails HTTP 400 (openai/codex#26753). The config-migration guard now always writes `enabled=false` and annotates your `config.toml`. Opt out with `LAZYCODEX_CONFIG_MIGRATION_DISABLED=1`.
entries.translated: **`multi_agent_v2` is force-disabled on every Codex session start.** With it on, every Codex turn fails HTTP 400 (openai/codex#26753). entries.original: **Sparkshell spark summaries: default model fixed and secret redaction removed.** The default is now the real `gpt-5.3-codex-spark` (the old `gpt-5.5-codex-spark` didn't exist). Summaries now reproduce values verbatim and no longer mask secrets.

entries.original: **Removed: keyword-detector `search`/`analyze` modes** and the **`anthropic-effort` max-effort hook.** `"search"`/`"analyze"` are no longer valid `keyword_detector.disabled_keywords`, and `"anthropic-effort"` is no longer a valid `disabled_hooks` value.
